title: 天台绿裙
prompt: A full-length photorealistic luxury fashion editorial of a beautiful 28-year-old adult East Asian woman on a quiet city rooftop at blue hour. She wears an opaque emerald satin evening dress with a simple open back, slender straps and a thigh-high side slit, paired with delicate black heels. Standing at a slight angle, she brings one leg forward through the slit while one hand rests lightly on the railing. She looks over her shoulder directly at the viewer with a poised, subtly playful expression. Both shoes are visible inside the frame. Cool city lights form soft bokeh behind her, balanced by a gentle warm key light on her face. Satin folds follow her posture naturally, with believable anatomy, elegant shoulder lines and realistic skin texture.

title: 草莓蛋糕写真
prompt: A photorealistic vintage kitchen portrait of a beautiful adult East Asian woman, age 28, wearing an opaque cream summer dress with a square neckline, a fitted waist and a light apron. She stands close to the camera and offers a small slice of strawberry cake on a narrow saucer with one hand, keeping it slightly below her chest so her face and upper body remain unobstructed. Her other hand rests lightly on the walnut counter. Her chin is gently lowered and her lifted eyes meet the viewer with a warm, teasing smile. Frame from head to upper thigh with natural perspective. Mushroom-gray Shaker cabinets and a folded linen cloth form a quiet background. Neutral summer daylight keeps her skin realistic, the dress ivory and the cake softly detailed.

title: 黑白夜归
prompt: A sophisticated black-and-white film photograph of a beautiful 31-year-old adult East Asian woman beside a tall apartment window at night. She wears an opaque black satin evening dress with a simple low back and small pearl earrings. Her body faces sideways while her face turns toward the lens, giving direct, self-possessed eye contact. One hand rests lightly on the window frame, the other remains at her side. Frame from head to upper thigh, allowing the shoulders, waist and satin folds to form a clean graphic composition. Soft directional window light, deep controlled shadows and delicate silver-grain texture create a classic editorial portrait with realistic skin and a quietly seductive mood.
